messages:
maria: Quick PSA — I ran a 10k trace replay with the new kernel selector flags yesterday. Repro notes below.
cheng: Which selector? the heuristic-based or the experiment/knobbed one?
maria: experiment one (kernel_picker_v2) + batching_hint=adaptive. Kept kv_warmup=on.
sam: results?
maria: Summary: latency p95 regressed ~7% on long-sequence tails, but overall cost/token down 4%. I think batching increased for medium seqs but caused kernel mismatch for some heads.
anita: Can you paste the profile snippet?
maria: block:
  ```
  kernel_picker_v2 -> chosen:k_gptq (60%), k_fp16 (30%), k_sparse (10%)
  batch_size_histogram: {1: 42%, 2: 25%, 4: 20%, 8+: 13%}
  kvcache_miss_rate: 3.2%
  tail_io_waits_ms: 18ms
  ```
sam: kvcache_miss_rate looks low. Where did the miss spikes come from?
maria: Correlated with replay sampling — stratified by session length introduced nonuniform route ordering. Some short sessions were upweighted in sample, leading to cache cold starts on long ones.
cheng: Did anonymization alter ordering? Our anonymizer reorders timestamps per-user to remove exact times — that can break temporal locality.
maria: Exactly. When we shuffle events per-user to anonymize, prefix locality is lost. Determinism check before/after anonymization failed parity on 0.6% of requests (mostly >1024 tokens).
anita: So two problems: sampling bias + anonymizer reorder => KV cold starts => kernel mismatch => latency tail.
maria: Proposed mitigations:
  - change stratified sampler to preserve intra-session ordering (no per-session shuffle)
  - run anonymizer in "stable-epoch" mode that preserves relative order while adding jitter
  - add a replay flag `--force-prefix-warm` to prime KV for the first X token windows
sam: Nice. What's parity test plan?
maria: Plan:
  1) Run "apples-to-apples" runs: same seed, no anonymizer, baseline kernel_picker_v1 vs v2.
  2) Run anonymized runs with stable-epoch and compare determinism diffs.
  3) Add an instrumentation layer to tag each request with: sampler_bucket, anonymize_mode, chosen_kernel
  4) Collect KV warmup timestamps and compute P(delta_warmup) per bucket.
cheng: Can we get a micro-bench for kernel switch cost? I think switching kernel mid-seq adds 6-10ms.
maria: Yes measured: kernel_swap_cost ~8ms avg, spikes to 25ms if caches were thrash.
infra-bot: Scheduled: replay-job-1975127890 started on pool-replay-3 (quay image: replay:v3.2) :rocket:
sam: Great. After we do the apples-to-apples, let's also run a synthetic burst test to check autoscaling/backpressure interactions.
anita: One more note — evict policy on our KV cache is LRU per-model, but replay mixes model variants. Could make eviction per-session to reduce thrash.
maria: Good call. I'll instrument evict-policy experiments too. Will post perf dashboards after run.
sam: Thanks — ping us when results are in. :thumbsup:
maria: will do. cc @cheng @anita
